criteria.name: AC1 — Per-Subtask Worktree Creation (Multi-Subtask Groups)
criteria.evidence: runImplement creates per-subtask worktrees at <worktreePath>-st<subtaskId> from pipeline.branch when subtasks.length >= 2

criteria.name: AC2 — Single-Subtask Groups Use Main Worktree
criteria.evidence: Single-subtask groups use pipeline.worktreePath directly; isMultiGroup check gates worktree creation

criteria.name: AC3 — Agent Session Runs in Isolated Worktree
criteria.evidence: createSession receives cwd from subtaskWorktrees.get(subtask.id) for multi-group, pipeline.worktreePath for single

criteria.name: AC4 — Successful Changes Cherry-Picked Back
criteria.evidence: After Promise.allSettled, successful subtasks' commits are cherry-picked onto main worktree in ID order via git cherry-pick <branch>..<stBranch>

criteria.name: AC5 — Failed Subtask Changes Discarded
criteria.evidence: Only fulfilled results are cherry-picked; rejected subtasks are skipped

criteria.name: AC6 — Per-Subtask Worktree Cleanup
criteria.evidence: finally block removes all per-subtask worktrees via git worktree remove --force, deletes branches, and prunes metadata

criteria.name: AC7 — Container Mode Support
criteria.evidence: Per-subtask worktree .git files are patched via _patchWorktreeGitFile when container mode is enabled

criteria.name: AC8 — Full Group Failure Surface
criteria.evidence: Existing results.every(r => r.status === 'rejected') check preserves original behavior; finally block ensures cleanup

criteria.name: AC9 — Crash Recovery
criteria.evidence: _cleanStaleSubtaskWorktrees() called at runImplement start scans <worktree-base>/<slug>-st* and removes stale worktrees; cleanupTaskArtifacts also handles orphaned per-subtask worktrees

additional_issues.description: Cherry-pick empty range handling could be more robust (currently relies on git error catching in _execGit). Consider pre-checking with git log --oneline <range> to skip no-op cherry-picks gracefully.
